series.title: Lost
series.description: After Oceanic Flight 815 crashes on a remote Pacific island, the survivors discover that the place is shaped by hidden stations, rival communities, impossible phenomena and a history reaching far beyond the crash. Their attempts to escape pull them into the Dharma Initiative, the Others and a struggle over the island itself, while memory, fate and identity repeatedly complicate the simple business of getting home.
series.collectionScope: Custom seven-season SceneSense SPECIAL EDITION structure. Season 7 shares the 2010 year span of Season 6. Afterlife flashbacks are excluded and will be catalogued separately. Episode counts and episode rows remain intentionally pending until the SPECIAL EDITION cut is mapped.
